execution_semantics: Concurrent independent candidate backtests, consumed in identical parameter order; unchanged neighbourhood, RNG, score and patience. Same native engine and cache validated by actual probes.

stage48.initial_candidates: all stage12 shortlisted parameters plus frozen default
stage48.search: GA with local one-coordinate or one-weight-unit-transfer mutation
stage48.reuse: only exact matching parameter/year/start traces from completed stage12; additional starts run native account
stage48.selection: parent typical gate plus tail rule, identical start coverage

final_candidates.rule: top3 stage48 typical plus top3 stage48 tail among candidates within0.05 of best typical, plus stage48 winner plus default; deduplicate
final_candidates.coverage: every previous-year OOF trading-day start for scored years2012..2021
final_candidates.selection: original parent typical gate within0.05 then maximum mean q20; no holdout access before winner lock

source_policy: Never modify running stage12 bound sources; refinements are separate entry points and separately sealed
resume_policy: Restore exact generation population/RNG/checkpoint; future partial-generation trials cannot participate in earlier-generation selection
